note: Focused source-shaped tests execute leader-first and alternate-voter transport recovery, known/nil NotLeader handling, shared budget exhaustion, successful peer promotion, and ordered same-task rebuild. Store token limits, forwarding, follower/stale policies, async paths, and the rest of the three-store suite remain explicitly external.

One request-scoped selector tries the leader first, records the exact attempt result, excludes a failed store, and retries the same logical task on an alternate voter without changing leader-read request semantics. Follower, stale, learner, forwarding, and async policies stay external.

The shared per-region TiKVRPC budget and capped equal-jitter backoff bound repeated selected-peer failure before alternate selection or RegionMiss rebuild. Configurable short-read fast rotation, forwarding, active in-flight cancellation, and the remaining suite sequence stay external.

Focused source-shaped runtime tests cover structured connection and remote-Canceled recovery, exact-generation close, foreground liveness, shared-store invalidation, alternate selection/promotion, StoreNotMatch force close, region-error retry/rebuild, and cancellation barriers. Locks, store limits, async paths, forwarding, TLS, active in-flight cancellation, and background recovery remain open.

A selected connection failure consumes the failed attempt, observes liveness, invalidates the exact canonical store generation, backs off, and reselects a surviving peer for the same task. Background recovery and async send remain external.

Caller cancellation returns before attempt completion, cache/store mutation, health probing, backoff, or redispatch. Active cancellation of an already in-flight blocking RPC and the async API remain external.
Cancellation before or during retry scheduling prevents PD reload, selector mutation, backoff completion, and future dispatch. Active in-flight cancellation and the async API remain external.

A caller-originated cancellation is structurally distinct from remote gRPC Canceled and bypasses exact close, liveness, store invalidation, region reload, and backoff. Active in-flight cancellation and async send remain external.

StoreNotMatch force-closes the selected address, consumes the exact attempt, mutates the region cache through the single retry authority, and reselects without response-accounting duplication. Other region errors and async send remain external.
